question.body:
A particle moves along the $x$-axis with position at time $t$ given by $x(t)= e^(- t) sin t$ for $0 <= t <= 2 pi$.

(a) Find the time $t$ at which the particle is farthest to the left. Justify your answer.

(b) Find the value of the constant $A$ for which $x(t)$ satisfies the equation $A x''(t)+ x'(t)+ x(t)= 0$ for $0 < t < 2 pi$.
